# Feature Comparison

`comparison/feature-comparison` &middot; section-level &middot; category: comparison

## Purpose

Which features each option has, as rows of yes, no or partial marks. A checklist preset of the comparison table.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | listItems |  |
| `rows` | list of object { label, values } (1 to 20) |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `intro` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: The first column highlighted.
- **zebra**: Alternating row shading. Sets `tableVariant: zebra`.
- **plain**: No highlighted column. Sets `highlightFirst: false`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `highlightFirst` | boolean | `true` |
| `tableVariant` | one of `default`, `zebra`, `tinted` | `"default"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables, colors and borders honored. | Fine. Columns shrink on phones. | Cells on the surface or background swap via dm-* classes. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('comparison/feature-comparison', {
  "heading": "Free vs Team",
  "columns": [
    "Team",
    "Free"
  ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "label": "Unlimited projects",
      "values": [
        "yes",
        "no"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Shared workspaces",
      "values": [
        "yes",
        "no"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Version history",
      "values": [
        "yes",
        "partial"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Priority support",
      "values": [
        "yes",
        "no"
      ]
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```
